status: Held reviewable reconstruction checkpoint; own authoring and official render jobs finished; scene01 write ownership released to root; photographic acceptance false
implemented: Rebuilt the foreground stone lantern as physically eroded rounded stone solids, separate recessed firebox windows and lattice, thick closed hipped stone roof, closed surface-conformed moss carpet, rounded seed and eighteen separate closed carved lotus petals. R07 moves the actual bowl frieze to its visible curved stone surface.

Added an inner housed hall reveal, two partially opened solid framed door leaves, ceiling bosses and candleholders. Altar, sculpture and sanctuary back screen move forward together2.10m. Reused four instances of the existing licensed actual peony source surface, with original source attributes unchanged, uniform1.08 scale and declared aged-gilt PBR.

Rebuilt front timber coloration and paint-over-grain layer; reduced lower front column radius.34→.295m; lowered main roof rise6.2→5.25m while all roof-following bearing construction reads the updated roof surface.

Authored rooted azalea branches, shoots, petioles, modeled leaf blades and funnel corollas;17,640 twig-carried leaves,980 flowers before the unchanged underplanting count. Lower and wider scan-stone buttresses replace three high stretched shore forms.

Rebuilt the framing maple lamina as folded radial rings with serrated unequal lobes. Connected twigs carry leaves through their actual basal vertex; the main scaffold becomes oblique and three hanging sprays carry continuous side shoots and opposite leaf pairs.

Removed inherited emissive water-grid flecks and authored glowing trails, retaining actual scene planar reflection, ripple-normal Fresnel and GGX sunlight. Authored sky altitude spectral balance is shared by displayed sky and PMREM; increased sun/courtyard irradiance.

validation.scopeLimit: The six audited new stone/moss prototypes are finite, positively wound and have zero degenerate, boundary/nonmanifold or unopposed edges. This is not full-scene topology, pedestrian clearance, engineering adequacy or photographic acceptance.

personalReview: Personally inspected HD01 and208R06 complete images; R02,R03,R04 full/hero/true low; R05 full/hero; R06 full/hero and both true low cameras; R07b full/hero and R07 both low cameras. All19 successful frames in13 own official reports have been inspected. R01 GLSL failures and R07 ENOSPC zero-byte PNG/complete failed receipt remain preserved.

remainingVisualFailures: The scene remains conspicuously CG versus HD01: native GI, sunset radiance/backscatter, cool roof/sky contrast and warm metal response do not reproduce the photograph.
Main hall facade/roof/carpentry correspondence remains approximate. Reused peony and dragon source artifacts are different from the reference and do not establish historical/cultural equivalence.

The stone lantern still has simplified, regular carving, clean window geometry and synthetic mineral/moss appearance. The improved curved relief is visible but does not match the detailed reference carving.

Maple and middle-ground foliage remain too regularly clustered; several inherited shrubs still read as horizontal layers. Ground planting, leaf translucency and rock weathering need more natural variation.
True bridge-low view exposes dark inherited bank/retaining transitions. New root and foliage placement is real3D, but complete walking/headroom clearance is unverified.
Water is no longer an emissive checkerboard; it is darker and lacks the reference intensity/shape of warm reflected glints.
No motion or Cycles job was rendered by219. Custom native mineral, thin-leaf/corolla and water shaders have not been verified against the current physical exporter.
